migration_source.boundary: The frozen R14 source is retained for audit only. Current product meaning comes from the owning Linear module ticket; implemented engineering truth comes from GitHub formal contracts and merged code.

claim_boundary: CURRENT means the document may appear in the default design route under its recorded source and review boundary. It does not prove current product approval, implementation, author usability, semantic quality, or construction authorization.

status_definitions.CURRENT: May appear in the default design route; still subordinate to the owning Linear module ticket, formal contracts, current code, and accepted results.
status_definitions.WAITING_REWRITE: Kept for history and partial mechanics; must be reconciled with the owning Linear module ticket and formal contracts before related module code work.
status_definitions.SUPERSEDED: Replaced or retired from the current route; follow superseded_by.
status_definitions.HISTORICAL: Research/history artifact outside the product design route.

nearby_rewrite_rule.rule: 哪个模块要开工，先回读所属 Linear 模块票和 GitHub 正式合同；设计稿冲突时先改为 WAITING_REWRITE，校准完成后才可恢复 CURRENT。
nearby_rewrite_rule.enforcement: INDEX default route must contain CURRENT documents only; checker fails closed on non-current default routes.
